title: NukkadSale: sell on WhatsApp, get paid on UPI – full product tour
description:
Selling in WhatsApp groups? NukkadSale turns your group into a shop: one order link per sale, an exact amount for every order so you know who paid, stock held while buyers pay, and a khata that writes itself – in English and Hindi, on any phone.

This tour shows the real app, start to finish: posting a sale, what your buyers see, confirming payments, packing and sending, and your khata.
